title: Derived internal Hom commutes with restriction to opens
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], let $K,L$ be objects of the derived category $D(\mathcal O_X)$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let $U\subseteq X$ be open, with restrictions $K|_U,L|_U\in D(\mathcal O_U)$ computed termwise on representing complexes. Then there is a canonical isomorphism $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_U}(K|_U,L|_U)\cong R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(K,L)|_U$ in $D(\mathcal O_U)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom].
